searchDocs.content: </> Fader.new( parent: Instance ,-- Where the AudioFader instance is created props: { Name: string?, Volume: number? }?-- Name, and a starting Volume (clamped to 0 - 3) ) → Fader Creates a new Fader under parent.

searchDocs.title: Set​
searchDocs.content: </> Fader:Set( volume: number-- 0 (silent) to 3, where 1 is unchanged ) → () Sets the volume immediately, cancelling any running fade. While muted, the volume is stored for when you unmute.

searchDocs.title: Tween​
searchDocs.content: </> Fader:Tween( goal: number,-- Target volume, 0 - 3 tweenInfo: TweenInfo? -- Defaults to a 1 second linear tween ) → Promise-- Resolves when the tween completes, cancelled when interrupted or the Fader is destroyed Tweens the volume to goal. While muted, the goal is stored for when you unmute and the Promise resolves right away.

searchDocs.title: FadeOut​
searchDocs.content: </> Fader:FadeOut( duration: number,-- Seconds, greater than 0 goal: number?-- Target volume, 0 - 3. Defaults to 0 ) → Promise-- See Fader:Tween Fades the volume down linearly over duration seconds.

searchDocs.title: FadeIn​
searchDocs.content: </> Fader:FadeIn( duration: number,-- Seconds, greater than 0 goal: number?-- Target volume, 0 - 3. Defaults to 1 ) → Promise-- See Fader:Tween Fades the volume up linearly over duration seconds.

searchDocs.title: Mute​
searchDocs.content: </> Fader:Mute( noTween: boolean?-- Cut immediately instead of fading ) → Promise-- Resolves when the fade completes, right away with noTween Toggles mute. Muting fades to 0 over 0.5 seconds and remembers the volume; calling it again fades back to that volume.

searchDocs.title: Destroy​
searchDocs.content: </> Fader:Destroy() → () Destroys the Fader: its instance, and every wire into or out of it. Destroying the instance directly does the same.

searchDocs.title: new​
searchDocs.content: </> Routing.new( parent: Instance ,-- The audio instance to route pins: {EnumItem }?-- Pin types (from Enums.Pin) to use when parent isn't an audio instance ) → Routing Creates a Routing for parent. Pins are read from the instance; for anything that isn't an audio instance, pass them. Components create their own Routing, so you rarely need this.

searchDocs.title: Wire​
searchDocs.content: </> Routing:Wire( from: { Instance: Instance , PinType: EnumItem , Pin: string? },-- Source instance, its Enums.Pin type, and pin name (nil for the default pin) to: { Instance: Instance , PinType: EnumItem , Pin: string? }-- Target instance, its Enums.Pin type, and pin name (nil for the default pin) ) → () Wires two explicit pins together, for example one channel of an AudioChannelSplitter. Allowed: Output to Input, Input to Output.

searchDocs.title: WireTo​
searchDocs.content: </> Routing:WireTo( to: Instance ,-- The audio instance to wire into, usually another component's In toPin: string?-- Input pin on to, for example "Sidechain". Defaults to its default input pin ) → () Wires this instance's output into to. Errors if to has no input pins, or no input pin named toPin.

searchDocs.title: WireFrom​
searchDocs.content: </> Routing:WireFrom( from: Instance ,-- The audio instance to wire from, usually another component's Out fromPin: string?-- Output pin on from, for example "Left". Defaults to its default output pin ) → () Wires from's output into this instance. Errors if from has no output pins, or no output pin named fromPin.

searchDocs.title: Destroy​
searchDocs.content: </> Routing:Destroy() → () Destroys the Routing: every wire it created, every wire connected into its instance (those live under the source'sAudioRouter), and its AudioRouter folder.

searchDocs.title: Start​
searchDocs.content: This item only works when running on the client. Client </> Orchestra:Start() → () Builds the mixer: MainOut, the Master Fader, and a mix bus + listener for every bus in Config.MIX_BUSES. Errors on the server; warns and does nothing if already started.

searchDocs.title: AddMix​
searchDocs.content: </> Orchestra:AddMix(busName: string) → Fader? Adds a mix bus: a Fader named MixBus:<busName> in SoundService.Mixes, wired into Master. Warns and returns nothing if the bus already exists. Call Orchestra:AddListener to give it a listener.

searchDocs.title: AddListener​
searchDocs.content: This item only works when running on the client. Client </> Orchestra:AddListener( busName: string-- An existing bus, see Orchestra:AddMix ) → AudioListener Adds an AudioListener on the camera for an existing mix bus, hearing emitters whose AudioInteractionGroup is busName, and wires it into that bus.
